releaseNotes:
- FIXED: App now downloads and installs the exact package for your phone - no more 'App not installed' errors
- Update downloads now show real progress (percent) and can be paused - 'Later' re-prompts after 12 hours
- Updates are only forced for very old versions now
- SOS vibration, sound and snooze all working
- Language switcher available in Profile > Preferences
